description:
The Prime Radiant team is formed by Guilherme Almeida Zeni and Kauê Melo. Guilherme is a software engineer with more than ten years of experience and he is mostly responsible for the web app. Kauê is an electrical engineer who has specialized in data science, so in this project he is handling the processing of the NASA FIRMS archive and the method that puts MODIS and VIIRS on one scale.

App: https://primeradiant.zenus.systems

Code: https://github.com/Guillhermm/prime-radiant
